findings.title: Call to conditional-passkey helper does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without arguments, but the only method defined in its superclass is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user). There is no zero-argument overload in the supplied inheritance chain, so the services module fails compilation. Pass the context user or provide an appropriate overload.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are disabled for ordinary unidentified logins
findings.body: The new helper requires user != null, and both initial form rendering and error challenges now use it. During an ordinary login context.getUser() is null, so fillContextForm() is no longer called and the login page receives neither conditional WebAuthn UI attributes nor a WebAuthn challenge. This removes the existing username-less passkey login path (including for passkey-only users) and breaks the existing discoverable-key login tests. Passkeys must remain enabled when no user has yet been selected, as well as during re-authentication.
